description: Erect herbs 40–100 cm; stems simple or laxly branched, terete, densely covered with spreading long glandular hairs. Leaves with patently glandular-pilose; petioles 0.5–3 cm; blades ovate-oblong, 3–9 by 1.5–6 cm, acute at apex, cuneate to rounded occasionally subcordate at base, double crenate-serrate, sparsely to almost densely hirsute on both surfaces. Flowers in terminal lax leafy racemes. Bracts foliaceous below, gradually diminishing and getting narrowly lanceolate to linear above. Pedicels slender, 1 mm long in flower, 2–5 mm long in fruit. Bracteoles filiform, 6–7 mm. Calyx 7–8 mm long in flower, 9–18 mm long in fruit, densely and patently glandular-pilose; outer 3 lobes narrowly lanceolate, obtuse; inner 2 lobes linear, subacute. Corolla purple, 8–25 mm long, pilose outside; upper lip oblong, rounded or slightly emarginate at apex; lobes of flower lip narrowly oblong. Capsule conical-ovoid, 7 by 5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma caerulea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 147. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual herbs; stems erect, 6–38 cm, simple or with lax, divaricate branches, quadrangular, narrowly winged on the ridges, sparsely pubescent. Leaves elliptic to oblong, 8–30 by 2.5–13 mm, acute at apex, narrowing into obsolete petioles, acute-serrate, pubescent above and on the nerves beneath. Flowers in terminal clusters with few to many flowers, occasionally solitary, axillary below. Flower bracts reduced, foliaceous; upper ones linear-lanceolate to linear, as long as the calyx. Bracteoles filiform, 4 mm long, glandular-pilose. Calyx 4–5 mm long in flower, 5–6 mm in fruit, spreadingly glandular-pilose; outer 3 lobes lanceolate, acuminate; inner 2 lobes linear-lanceolate, acuminate. Corolla pale rose, 7–8 mm long, pilose outside; upper lip elliptic, entire, 3 by 2 mm; flower lip as long as upper, 3-lobed, lobes elliptic. Capsule conical-ellipsoidal, acuminate, 3 by 2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma debilis . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems erect. simple or laxly branched, 20–50 cm, quadrangular, sparselysessile-glandular. Leaves sessile, oblong, subacute at apex, sub-auriculate at base, 7–35 by 1.5–10 mm, entire in flower half, minutely crenate-serrate in upper half, shortly hirsute on midrib above, glabrous beneath. Inflorescences terminal, pseudo-spicale, densely many-flowered, 1–3.5 by 1 cm, covered with leafy involucre-like bracts at base. Upper bracts broadly ovate, cordate, shortly petiolate, 4–6 by 4–5 mm, obtuse to subacute at apex, entire, glabrous or sparsely and shortly glandular-pilose on margins, reticulately nerved. Bracteoles filiform, 1.5 mm long, sparsely glandular-pilose. Calyx membranous, pellueid, sparsely sessile-glandular, glabrous or sparsely and shortly glandular-pilose on margin; outer 3 sepals broadly ovate, obtuse, 3 mm long in flower, 4 mm in fruit; inner 2 sepals lanceolate, acute, 2 by 1 mm. Corolla 8–9 mm long, pilose outside; upper lip broadly orbicular, ca 3 mm long and wide; flower lip as long as upper, 3-lobed, lobed orbicular. Capsule conical-globose, 2 by 1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma elshollzioides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Erect herbs 50–100 cm; stems simple or laxly branched, densely glandular-villous. Leaves densely villous; petioles 1–10 mm; blades broadly ovate to oblong-ovate, 2.5–7 by 1–3 cm, obtuse at apex, obtuse to rounded at base, crenate-serrate. Inflorescences in terminal, cylindrical, dense pseudo-spikes with many flowers, 1.5–5 by 1.2–1.5 cm, densely glandular-villous. Flower bracts reduced, foliaceous; upper ones oblong-lanceolate to linear, longer than the flower. Bracteoles linear, 3 mm long. Calyx 4 mm long, densely glandular-villous; upper lobes largest, oblong-lanceolate, subacute; others linear-lanceolate, acute. Corolla violet, 9–11 mm long, glabrous outside; upper lip broadly orbicular, 2.5–3 mm long and wide; flower lip as long as upper, 3-lobed, lobes oblong. Capsule ovoid, 5 by 3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma hirsuta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 148. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual herbs; stems erect, simple or laxly branched, 15–70 cm, white-hirsute. Leaves petiolate, rarely subsessile; petioles 0.5–9 mm; lamina ovate to ovate-oblong, 1–7 by 0.5–2 cm, subacute at apex, cuneate and attenuate to the petiole, subacute serrate, hirsute above and on the nerves beneath. Flowers in terminal very dense-flowered, globose or shortly cylindrical heads of 0.5–3 by 1 cm, rarely solitary and axillary. Pedicels 0.2–4 cm long, hirsute. Bracts foliaceous below, lanceolate to linear-Ianceolate above. Bracteoles filiform, 4 mm long, hirsute. Calyx 4 mm long, densely hirsute; upper lobe broadly lanceolate, acute, 0.5 mm wide; others narrowly lanceolate, acute, 0.2–0.3 mm wide. Corolla violet, 5–6 mm long, glabrous outside; upper lip broadly ovate; flower lip deeply 3-lobed, as long as upper, lobes linear-oblong. Capsule ovoid, 3.5 by 2.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma indiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 150. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems branched from the base, prostrate, 15–50 cm, quadrangular; hirsute especially on the angles. Leaves with petioles 1–6 mm, hirsute; blades ovate or ovate-elliptic, 1–3.5 by 0.5–1.8 cm, obtuse or subacute at apex, rounded to cuneate at base, shallowly crenate-serrate, sparsely hirsute above, hispid on the nerves beneath. Flowers solitary and axillary or in clusters with few flowers on short peduncles. Pedicels 1–2 mm long, hirsute. Bracteoles filiform, 1–2 mm long. Calyx 5–6 mm long in flower, 7–8 mm in fruit; outer 3 sepals ovate-cordate, acute; inner 2 sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate; all sepals densely long-hirsute on margins. Corolla pale purple to white, 9–10 mm long, pilose outside; upper, lip elliptic, rounded at apex, 3 by 2.5 mm; flower lip as long as upper, shallowly 3-lobed, lobes lanceolate. Capsule ovoid, 3 by 2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma javanica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 152. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual herbs; stems erect, slender, simple or laxly branched, 10–40 cm, terete, densely pubescent. Leaves shortly petiolate; petioles 1–5 mm, pubescent; blades elliptic, ovate or ovate-orbicular, 0.5–3 by 0.4–1.5 cm, obtuse at apex, rounded at base, subacute-serrate, hirsute above, hispid on major nerves beneath. Flowers solitary and axillary or in lax pseudo-spikes. Pedicels 0.5–1 mm long, hirsute. Flower bracts foliaceous; upper ones smaller, orbicular, with slender petiole. Bracteoles filiform, 1 mm. Calyx 3–4 by 1–1.5 mm, densely hirsute with intermixed glandular-hairs; outer 3 lobes oblong-ovate, obtuse; inner 2 lobes lanceolate, subacute. Corolla mauve, 4 mm long, glabrous outside; upper lip broadly elliptic, ca 2 mm long and wide; flower lip much shorter than upper, 3-lobed, lobes orbicular, ca 0.7 mm long and wide. Capsule ovate-ellipsoidal, 2.5 by 1 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Adenosma microcephala. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems erect, 20–90 cm tall, sub-bifariously pubescent. Leaves membranous; petioles 1–2 mm; blades oblong-ovate or oblong-lanceolate, 1–5 by 0.5–2 cm, acute at apex, cuneate-attenuate into the petiole, coarsely acute-serrate, hirsute on both surfaces. Flowers solitary and axillary, or in lax terminal spikes; pedicels 0.3–0.8 mm, hirsute. Bracteoles filiforrn, 4–6 mm, long-hirsute on margin. Calyx 4–5 mm long and wide, 10-nerved, 5-lobed; lobes deltoid-ovate, acuminate, ca 2 mm long and wide, hirsute on margin. Corolla yellow, 6–7 mm long; lobes broadly elliptic, ca 2.5 mm long and wide. Stamens didynamous; posterior 2 ca 3 mm long, filaments glabrescent; anterior 2 ca 4 mm long, filaments lanate. Capsule subglobose, 5–6 mm long and wide. Seeds 0.8–1 by 0.2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Alectra avensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 222. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems laxly branched, erect, up to 1.5 m, densely glandular-pilose. Leaves opposite, alternate upwards, sessile, narrowly lanceolate, 3–7 by 0.4–1 cm, acuminate at apex, tapering towards the base, shallowly acute-serrate, densely and shortly glandular-hairy on both surfaces. Flowers solitary and axillary, or racemose upwards; pedicels slender, 1–2.5 cm, densely glandular-hairy. Calyx 4–5 mm long, densely glandular-pilose; lobes lanceolate, acute. Corolla purple, cup-shaped part paler, 2–2.5 cm long. Capsule globose.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Angelonia goyazensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 217. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems 50–100 cm, g1abrous. Leaves, sessile, semi-amplexicaul, 5–15 by 0.5–2.5 cm, acuminate at apex, gradually narrowed to base, with distant small acute teeth, glabrous or scabrid on both surfaces. Inflorescences 10–20 cm, glabrous or scabrid, rarelyshort-glandular; pedicels 2–7 mm, glabrous or scabrid. Bracts linear to lanceolate, acuminate, 5–10 mm. Calyx campanulate, 5 by 4 mm in flower, 8 by 8 mm in fruit; lobes ovate, acuminate, scabrid. Corolla purple, 2–2.5 cm long; upper lip ca 8 by 10 mm; lower lip spreading, 10–13 by 15–18 mm; projections of the tube inside ca 1 mm long, pilose. Stamens , posterior pair ca 4 mm, anterior pair ca 8 mm; appendages of the anterior filaments globose, ca 1 mm. Capsule globose, 5–7 mm, glabrous. Seeds ca 0.4 by 0.25 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Artanema longifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 176. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual herbs; stems erect 20–50 cm. Leaves linear-lanceolate, acute at apex, narrowly attenuate to base, distally serrulate or entire, 1–7 by 0.2–0.5 cm; glabrous. Pedicels 0.5–2 mm long, scabrid. Bracteoles subulate, 1.5–2 mm, scabrid. Calyx 5–6 mm long in flower, 6–7 mm long in fruit, sparsely glandular-pilose on both surfaces, scabrid on margins; upper sepal largest, orbicular-ovate, 4–5 mm wide; two flower ones ovate, acute, ca 3 mm wide; two lateral ones smallest, linear, acuminate, 0.3–0.5 mm wide. Corolla whitish, 4–5 mm long, lobes orbicular, ca 0.8 mm long and wide. Capsule globose, 4 mm long and wide. Seeds ca 0.3–0.35 by 0.2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bacopa floribunda. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 146. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Prostrate herbs; stems 10–40 cm, much branched, rooting at the nodes. Leaves spathulate or obovate, obtuse at apex, entire, 6–20 by 1–5 mm. Pedicels 6–15 mm long, glabrous. Bracteoles linear, 2–3 mm. Calyx 5–6 mm long, glabrous; upper one and flower two sepals ovate, acute or subacute, 2.5 mm wide; two lateral ones lanceolate, acuminate, 1.5 mm wide. Corolla white or pale violet, 8–10 mm long; lobes subequal, oblong-obovate, rounded or subemarginate at apex, ca 4 by 2.5 mm. Capsule ovoid, 5 by 3 mm. Seeds ca 0.5–0.6 by 0.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bacopa monnieri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 145. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems slender, ascending, laxly branched, densely stellate-tomentose. Leaves ovate to oblong-lanceolale, 3–9 by 1.5–4 cm, acuminate at apex, rounded at base, glabrous above, densely covered with stellate fulvous or white tomentum beneath; petioles 6–12 mm long. Pedicels 6–12 mm long. Bracts linear to oblong, 1–7 mm. Calyx 5–6 by 4–5 mm, densely fulvous tomentose outside, white long-pilose inside, 5-dentate, teeth deiloid acute. Corolla brownish-yellow, 2–2.5 cm long, upper lip 8 mm long, pilose inside; flower lip deeply 3-lobed, lobes ovate-lanceolate. Capsule broadly ovate, acute, 10 by 8 mm, tomentose. Seeds 4–6 mm mm long, 0.7 wide.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Brandisia discolor. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 143. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems stout, simple, erect, 30–50 cm, sparsely pubescent; radical leaves withering in flower. Leaves opposite, sessile; flower oblanceolate or linear-oblanceolate, 1.5–5 cm by 4–7 mm, obtuse or subacute at apex, attenuate towards the base, undulate or 1–3-dentate, scabrid on both surfaces; middle and upper leaves linear, acuminate, 3–10 cm by 2–7 mm, scabrid on both surfaces, 3–4-serrate, teeth deltoid-linear, acute. Inflorescences quadrangular, densely flowered, 1–7 cm long, ca 1.2 cm wide, densely covered by long white hairs. Bracts broadly ovate to orbicular-ovate, cuspidate, 5–6 mm long and wide, subequalling the calyx, densely villous on both surfaces. Bracteoles 2, ovate, acuminate, 5–6 by 3 mm. Calyx tubular, 6 by 2 mm, densely covered by white long hairs; lobes linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 2 by 0.8 mm. Corolla blue, ca 1 cm long, tube 8 by 1 mm, hirsute outside; lobes obovate-orbicular, ca 1.5 mm long and wide. Capsule ovoid, acute, ca 4 by 2 mm. Seeds ca 0.5 by 0.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buchnera cambodiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 230. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems slender, simple, 20–80 cm, pubescent. Leaves opposite, alternate upwards; flower sessile, occasionally shortly petiolate, obovate, elliptic or oblong, 1–5 by 0.7–1.8 cm, obtuse at apex, attenuate to base, entire or obscurely crenate, scabrid on both surfaces; middle and upper leaves lanceolate to linear, acute at apex, attenuate to base, sessile, 1–4 cm by 1.5–9 mm, entire, undulate or obscurely 2–3-demate, scabrid on both surfaces. Inflorescences densely flowered, 0.5–4 cm long, 0.7–1.3 cm wide. Bracts ovate, acuminate, shorter than calyx. Bracteoles 2, lanceolate, acuminate, ca 3 mm. Calyx 4 by 1 mm, pubescent; lobes linear, aristate-acuminate. Corolla purple, ca 1 cm long; tube cylindric ca 8 by 0.5 mm, pubescent; lobes subequal, elliptic or obovate, 1.5 mm long and wide. Capsule oblong-ovoid or oblong, 4–5 by 2 mm, subequalling or longer than persistent calyx. Seeds ca 0.45 by 0.25 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buchnera cruciata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 230. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems stout, simple, 25–50 cm, hirsute or villous; radical leaves withering in flower. Leaves opposite, sessile; flower oblong, 1.5–3 by 0.6–1.5 cm, obtuse at apex, attenuate towards base, undulate or 2–3-dentate, scabrid on both surfaces; middle and upper leaves Iinear-oblong to linear-lanceolate, 1-3 cm by 1.5–7 mm, obtuse or acute at apex, entire or 2–3-dentate, scabrid. Inflorescences stout, densely flowered, 2–3 cm long, 1–1.3 cm wide, villous. Bracts ovate or broadly ovate, acuminate at apex, 4–5 by 3–5 mm, equalling or slightly shorter than the calyx, villous. Bracteoles 2, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 5 by 1 mm. Calyx tubular, 5 by 2 mm, scabrid; lobes linear-lanceolate, acuminate, ca 2 mm long. Corolla purple, ca 8 mm long; tube ca 6 by 1 mm, densely hirsute; upper 2 and lateral 2 lobes of flower lip obovate-oblong, ca 2.5 by 1 mm; central lobe of flower lip broadest, ca 2.5 by 1.5 mm. Capsule ovoid, 4 by 2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buchnera tetrasticha. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 229. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Calyx 8–10 by 3–4 mm, densely hispid. Corolla 1.5–2.5 cm long, entirely yellow, rarely with pink lobes. Upper part of staminal filaments patently lanate; one locule of anther much narrower than the other and longer spurred.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Centranthera cochinchinensis lutea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 228. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems erect, simple or few branched upwards, 10–50 cm, with spreading hispid hairs. Leaves opposite below, alternate upwards, obscurely petiolate, narrowly obovate, oblong-oblanceolate or lanceolate, obtuse or rounded rarely subacute at apex, attenuate-angustate into petiole, 1–5 cm by 3–12 mm, entire or obscurely 2–3-dentate, prominently uninerved, hispid on both surfaces. Flowers solitary and axillary. Bracteoles 2, setaceous, 1–2 mm long, hispid. Calyx membranous, attenuate-acuminate at apex, 10–15 by 3–5 mm, spreadingly hispid. Corolla purple, 2.5–3.5 cm long, obscurely bilabiate, 5-lobed; lobes orbicular, 3–4 mm long and wide. Stamens 4; filaments lanate in apical parts; anther-Ioculi unequal, the one narrower than the other. Capsule oblong, acuminate at apex, 8–10 by 4–5 mm. Seeds ovoid, ca 0.6 by 0.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Centranthera siamensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 227. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems laxly branched, erect or ascending, 6–20 cm, glabrous or sparsely hispid. Leaves opposite below, alternate upwards; flower ovate-oblong, small; middle and upper larger, linear to linear-filiform, 5–25 by 0.5–1.5 mm, acute to obtuse at apex, entire or remotely and obscurely dentate, glabrous or sparsely hispid, rarely with intermixed glandular hairs, uninerved. Flowers solitary in the middle to upper leaf-axils, subsessile. Bracteoles 2, at the base of pedicel, linear, ca 1 mm. Calyx ca 3 by 2 mm, subacute at apex, glabrous or hispid, rarely with intermixed glandular hairs. Corolla with maroon tube and yellow lobes, ca 1 cm long; upper lip ca 2 mm long, with two elliptic lobes; lower lip ca 3 mm long, with three broadly elliptic lobes. Stamens 4; filaments hirsute in the upper parts; anther-loculi conspicuously spurred at base. Capsule globose-ovoid, 4 by 3 mm, glabrous or hispid. Seeds ca 0.9 by 0.45 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Centranthera tranquebarica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 226. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems 1–2 m, with dense, minute, crispate, soft hairs. Leaves narrowly oblong or oblong-lanceolate, acuminate at both ends, 8–22 by 3–5.5 cm, acute-serrate, sparsely pilose above, subdensely and softly pilose on the nerves beneath; petioles 1–4 cm long, with minute soft hairs. Inflorescences in 2–6-flowered cymes at upper leaf-axils, 4–7 cm long. Peduncles and pedicels with minute soft hairs. Calyx tubular, 8–25 by 4–10 cm in flower, soft-hairy. Corolla white or pale violet, 3–5.5 cm long, sparsely glandular-pilose outside. Capsule not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cyrtandromoea grandiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 155. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems 1–3 m, glabrous. Leaves oblong to broadly oblong, acuminate at both ends, 20–30 by 5–12 cm, glabrous on both surfaces; teeth very shallow, each with a short aristate projection at apex; petioles 2–5 cm, almost glabrous. Inflorescences many-flowered, clustered at the flower ligneous stem, 6–10 cm long. Peduncles and pedicels slender, pubescent. Bracts small, membranous, obovate, apiculate. Calyx tubular, membranous, 15–20 by 6–10 mm in flower, 20–25 by 10–15 mm in fruit, sparsely pubescent. Corolla white, 3–5 cm long, glandular-pilose outside. Capsule globose, 10 mm long and wide. Seeds numerous, ellipsoidal, ca 0.5 by 0.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cyrtandromoea grandis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 154. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems 0.7–1.5 m, brownish-pubescent when young, later glabrescent. Leaves oblong to broadly oblong, acuminate at both ends, 8–16 by 3.5–7 cm, sparsely pubescent on both surfaces, pubescent on the nerves beneath; teeth shallow, with short aristate projections at apex. Inflorescences axillary, shortly cymose, 1–2-flowered. Peduncle with pedicels 5–10 mm, brownish-pubescent. Bracts small, setaceous. Calyx tubular, 10–15 by 4–6 mm in flower, 15–20 by 12–15 mm in fruit, sparsely to densely pubescent in flower, later glabrescent. Corolla white or pinkish, 3 cm long, glandular-pilose outside. Capsule ellipsoidal or globose, 10–15 by 8–10 mm, glabrous. Seeds numerous, ellipsoidal, ca 0.5 by 0.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cyrtandromoea subsessilis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 155. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Semi-aquatic herbs, branched at base; stems simple, erect, 10–25 cm, glabrous. Leaves fleshy, sessile, flower ones oblong to obovate-oblong, 4–25 by 1–7 mm, obtuse at apex, attenuate to base, entire, glabrous, with 3–7 parallel nerves; middle and upper leaves much smaller, ovate, obtuse to subacute, gradually passing into bracts. Flowers in axils of upper leaves, solitary; pedicels slender, 1.5–8 mm, glabrous; cleistogamous flowers often in axils of middle leaves, subsessile. Calyx 1 mm long and wide, with sparse short glandular hairs; lobes elliptic, rounded at apex. Corolla whitish-purple, 5–6 mm long; upper lip 2–2.5 mm long, bilobed, lobes orbicular; flower lip 2.5–3 mm long, 3-lobed, lobes orbicular. Capsule globose, 2 mm long and wide.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dopatrium junceum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 175. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems up to 60 cm long, glabrous or sparsely hirsute. Leaves membranous, 5–30 by 5–20 mm, acute at apex, rounded or cuneate at base, occasionally attenuate into the petiole, mucronate-serrate, glabrous on both surfaces, occasionally sparsely scabrid on nerves beneath; petioles 5–15 mm, sparsely hirsute. Bracts linear, ca 1 mm. Calyx 4–5 by 3–4 mm in flower, 7–9 by 6–8 mm in fruit, glabrous or sparsely scabrid; wings 1.5–2 mm wide. Corolla yellow, 7–12 mm long; upper lip ca 3 by 2 mm, pilose on margin; lower lip ca 3 by 4 mm. Appendices of the anter-ior filaments clavate, ca 0.5 mm long. Capsule 5 by 2 mm. Seeds ca 0.35 by 0.3 m.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Legazpia polygonoides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 214. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems branched at base, erect, up to 25 cm, densely lanate. Leaves opposite, subsessile, semi-amplexicaul, 10–23 by 6–13 mm, elliptic, subacute at apex, narrowed into the obscure petiole, crenate-serrate, glabrous on both surfaces, pinnately nerved. Inflorescences in axillary short cymes with few flowers; peduncles less than 3 mm long; pedicels sessile, or up to 1 mm long. Bracteoles filiform, 1–1.5 mm, densely lanate. Calyx 3 mm long in flower, 4–5 mm long in fruit, densely lanate; lobes lanceolate, acuminate. Corolla pink, 8–10 mm long, glabrous outside, villous inside; upper lip broadly orbicular, emarginate; flower lip 3-lobed, lobes orbicular. Capsule ellipsoidal, 3 by 3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Limnophila balsamea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 168. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial herbs; stems prostate below, erect above, simple or laxly branched, 10–40 cm, densely lanate. Leaves opposite or 3–4-verticillate, membranous, rarely chartaceous, obovate, elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, rarely orbicular, 10–30 by 3–10 mm, acute or obtuse at apex, ettenuate to sessile base, semi-amplexicaul, crenate-serrate, subglabrous to hispid above, glabrous to hispid on major nerves beneath, punctate, pinnately nerved. Flowers solitary and axillary, or occasionally in laxly flowered terminal or axillary racemes; pedicels slender, 5–15 mm, densely and patenly lanate, interspersed with short glandular hairs. Bracteoles filiform to subulate, 1–2 mm. Calyx 4–6 by 2–3 mm. densely and patenly lanate, striate at maturity; lobes narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 2.5–4 mm. Corolla blue, with whitish tube, 12–15 mm, pilose outside, villous posteriorly inside; upper lip broadly orbicular, emarginate; lower lip 3-lobed, lobes orbicular. Capsule broadly ellipsoidal, more or less compressed, 4–5 by 3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Limnophila chinensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 2, 1990. Pg. 173. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Semi-aquatic herbs; stems 20–50 cm, basal parts prostrate, much branched, glabrous, aerial parts erect, sparsely glandular. Leaves opposite, sessile, sub-amplexicaul, oblong to ovate-oblong, 10–40 by 2–15 mm, subentire or crenate towards the apex, with many dots puncts on both surfaces, with 3–7 parallel nerves. Flowers solitary and axillary, sessile to subsessile. Bracteoles linear, 3–5 mm, glandular-puberulous. Calyx 5–6 mm long, sparsely glandular-puberulous, not striate at maturity; lobes lanceolate, acuminate, 3–3.5 mm long. Corolla 7–8 mm long; upper lip ovate, ca 2 mm long and wide, emarginate, punctate on margin; flower lip with orbicular 3 lobes, lobes ca 1.5 mm long and wide. description: Annual herbs 10–40 cm; stems suberect, sparsely patent-hirsute with intermixed glandular hairs. description: Stems erect, slender, 6–20 cm, somewhat ribbed, glabrous. Leaves sessile, subcarnose, filiform, 5–20 by 0.5–1 mm, entire, glabrous, uninerved. description: Stems laxly branched, erect, 25–35 cm, more or less ribbed, almost glabrous. description: Stems erect, many-branched, more than 20 cm, quadrangular, sparsely patent-hirsute with intermixed glandular hairs. description: Annual herbs 30–60 cm; stems laxly branched, erect, slender, glabrous except for sparse pubescence at the nodes. description: Annual herbs 4–10 cm; stems erect, more or less quadrangular, with short hispid hairs on the angles. description: Annual herbs, 5–15 cm; stems erect or diffuse, sparsely to densely hispid with intermixed spreading long hairs.
